Name: Slightly Cuter Xtardew
Author: Absynnian
Description:
Updated the character sprites in Xtardew Valley to for the most part match the ones from Slight Cuter Characters, base game and SVE versions.

Credits:
Poltergeister for https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1437 and https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4857
PseudoDiego for https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4399

Downloads.Description: All the sprites, just extract into your mods folder and it will overwrite them. Also an alternative version of Emily's sprite included, just have to rename it if you want to use it.
